paper: T. Hotta, cond-mat/0611113 (J. Phys. Soc. Jpn.), Multipole Susceptibility of Multiorbital Anderson Model Coupled with Jahn-Teller Phonons

replicated_claims.claim: Spin-orbit coupling splits the 14 f-orbital single-electron states into a lower j=5/2 sextet and upper j=7/2 octet with gap (7/2)*lambda.
The j=5/2 sextet CEF-splits into Gamma5 doublet + Gamma67 quartet, and the ground state flips with the sign of x (sign of B40): x>0 (B40<0) -> Gamma67 quartet ground for n=1.
replicated_claims.paper_value: Sec 2.2 / Fig 1(f): for W<0, x>0 the n=1 jj-scheme ground is Gamma67 quartet; sign flip inverts it to Gamma5 doublet
replicated_claims.replicated_value: x=+0.4 -> Gamma67 quartet ground (exc 8.32 meV); x=-0.4 -> Gamma5 doublet ground (exc 8.63 meV)

replicated_claims.claim: The 15 multipole operators (dipole 4u, quadrupole 3g/5g, octupole 2u/4u/5u) for j=5/2 form an orthonormal set under Tr(Xg Xg')=delta after redefinition.
replicated_claims.paper_value: orthonormal condition Tr(Xg Xg')=delta_{gg'} (text below eq 22)

replicated_claims.claim: For n=5 (j=5/2) the 4u dipole/octupole moments do NOT mix with the 5u octupole within the electronic model.
replicated_claims.paper_value: 'in the case of n=5, 4u moment is not mixed with 5u' (Sec 4.1); requires phonon B62 mixing which is absent in J=5/2 space
replicated_claims.replicated_value: <J4u|T5u> and <T4u|T5u> = O(1e-16) for all cartesian components

replicated_claims.claim: The reported maximized-susceptibility mixing coefficients (p,q,r) are unit-normalized eigenvectors.

out_of_scope: Full NRG solution of the multiorbital Anderson model (impurity + logarithmically discretized conduction bath, 3000 states/shell) -> requires dedicated NRG code, not attempted.
Dynamical Jahn-Teller phonon coupling with Nph=20 phonon basis and temperature-dependent multipole susceptibility chi(T) curves (Figs 2,3) -> depend on NRG; not attempted.
n=2,3,5 many-body effective-model Heff CEF levels (Fig 1a-e) with Racah E0,E1,E2 Coulomb -> the one-body n=1 building block is replicated exactly; many-body multi-electron diagonalization not built.
